native_standard_state_receipts.standard_state_policy: Native pure-liquid mu0 at this exact T/P; no fitted offset or pressure interpolation.

proposed_tolerances.origin: Existing M2 engineering targets; not empirical uncertainty estimates.

direct_transfer_screening.interpretation: Atom contributions only; no accompanying O/H or chemical response. Fraction ceilings concern isolated contributions without cancellation, not the full omission error.
direct_transfer_screening.background_sum_rule: Each element is counted once across its alternative destinations; pathwise ceilings do not allocate a joint error budget.

unrestricted_response_envelope.basis: All nonnegative redistributions conserving each total element; outer bounds only, not equilibrium predictions.

missing_evidence: Condition-matched upper bounds for omitted channels and their coupled response.
A bounded or expanded-channel metal boundary search, including incipient metal.

omission_scope.scope: Catalog inclusion only. Finite gas/cloud responses require separately reclosed comparisons; remaining metal transfer, empirical calibration and phase-boundary errors are unresolved.

water_reference_comparison.gas_fugacity_assumption: Ideal gas: supplied partial pressures equal fugacities.

host_comparison.interpretation: Descriptive differences; no compositional validity radius or unreported detection limit is assumed.

water_reference_comparison.concentration_basis: H2O-equivalent mass / glass mass; H2-induced OH is included, dissolved molecular H2 is not measured by this band.
water_reference_comparison.complete_liquid_conversion: Native-host ppm times (1 - supplied molecular-H2 mass fraction); arithmetic dilution only, not an H2 constitutive correction.
water_reference_comparison.uncertainty_scope: Concentration measurement marginals with fixed predictors and selected Per-5 background. Unknown correlations are not set to zero in the SD upper bound. Fugacity, temperature, composition, baseline-selection bias and transfer errors remain unbounded.

gate_policy: Numerical contact/closure, material calibration, global host stability and omitted-channel errors are independent obligations. Recounting a saved closed root retains its numerical result without establishing the physical evidence gates.
